name: K2-18 b public Figure 9 posterior-median demo
source_notes: Magma, temperature, cloud, and haze values are rounded visual readings of the one-dimensional posterior titles in published MELTYQ Figure 9.
They are posterior-median demonstration coordinates, not the maximum-likelihood vector used for the black curve in Figure 3.
The K2-18 b bulk values are editable public system values and are not documented as the exact fixed values used by MELTYQ.
All dataset offsets are initialized to zero because their exact units, ordering, grouping, and best-fit values require author confirmation.
The upper profile uses the TauREx NPoint default 10-percent smoothing window; the exact MELTYQ setting requires author confirmation.
The ExoExamples native forward path uses ExoJAX chord geometry and Simpson annulus integration; the TauREx legacy discretization remains an explicit MELTYQ compatibility option.

The Lee exp_decay profile follows the currently public TauREx-PyMieScatt formula pinned at commit 2973ace; the exact plugin revision and component grouping used for MELTYQ Figure 3 require author confirmation.
